23529-blackwood-s-edinburgh-magazine-vol.title: Blackwood S Edinburgh Magazine Volume 55 No 344 June 1844
23529-blackwood-s-edinburgh-magazine-vol.creator: Unknown
23529-blackwood-s-edinburgh-magazine-vol.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Fairy._ Over hill, over dale,  Thorough bush, thorough brier,  Over park, over pale,  Thorough flood, thorough fire,  I do wander ever where,  Swifter than the moones sphere;  And I serve the Fairy Queen,  To dew her orbs upon the green:  The cowslips tall her pensioners be;  In their gold coats spots you see;  Those be rubies, fairy favours,  In those freckles live their savours:  I must go seek some dewdrops here,  And hang a pearl in every cowslip's ear.

arxiv-2011-12585.title: Transient dynamics of the quantum light retrieved from Rydberg polaritons
arxiv-2011-12585.creator: Auxiliadora Padrón-Brito, Roberto Tricarico, Pau Farrera, Emanuele Distante, Klara Theophilo, Darrick Chang, Hugues de Riedmatten
arxiv-2011-12585.description: Abstract We study the photon statistics of weak coherent pulses propagating through a cold Rydberg atomic ensemble in the regime of Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency. We show experimentally that the value of the second-order autocorrelation function of the transmitted light strongly depends on the position within the pulse and heavily varies during the transients of the pulse.

arxiv-2203-06558.title: AutoGPart: Intermediate Supervision Search for Generalizable 3D Part Segmentation
arxiv-2203-06558.creator: Xueyi Liu, Xiaomeng Xu, Anyi Rao, Chuang Gan
arxiv-2203-06558.description: Abstract Training a generalizable 3D part segmentation network is quite challenging but of great importance in real-world applications. To tackle this problem, some works design task-specific solutions by translating human understanding of the task to machine’s learning process, which faces the risk of missing the optimal strategy since machines do not necessarily understand in the exact human way.

arxiv-2206-09150.title: Thompson Sampling for (Combinatorial) Pure Exploration
arxiv-2206-09150.creator: Siwei Wang, Jun Zhu
arxiv-2206-09150.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Siwei Wang, Jun Zhu. Existing methods of combinatorial pure exploration mainly focus on the UCB approach. To make the algorithm efficient, they usually use the sum of upper confidence bounds within arm set S S to represent the upper confidence bound of S S , which can be much larger than the tight upper confidence bound of S S and leads to a much higher complexity than necessary, since the empirical means of different arms in S S are independent.

arxiv-2212-05140.title: Local Neighborhood Features for 3D Classification
arxiv-2212-05140.creator: Shivanand Venkanna Sheshappanavar, Chandra Kambhamettu
arxiv-2212-05140.description: Abstract With advances in deep learning training strategies, the training of Point cloud classification methods is significantly improving. For example, PointNeXt, which adopts prominent training techniques and InvResNet layers into PointNet++, achieves over 7% improvement on the real-world ScanObjectNN dataset.

arxiv-2410-00415.title: Singularities in bivariate normal mixtures
arxiv-2410-00415.creator: Yutaro Kabata, Hirotaka Matsumoto, Seiichi Uchida, Masao Ueki
arxiv-2410-00415.description: Abstract We investigate mappings F = ( f 1 , f 2 ) : ℝ 2 → ℝ 2 F=(f_{1},f_{2})\colon\mathbb{R}^{2}\to\mathbb{R}^{2} where f 1 , f 2 f_{1},f_{2} are bivariate normal densities from the perspective of singularity theory of mappings, motivated by the need to understand properties of two-component bivariate normal mixtures.

arxiv-2410-06589.title: A Family of LZ78-based Universal Sequential Probability Assignments
arxiv-2410-06589.creator: Naomi Sagan, Tsachy Weissman
arxiv-2410-06589.description: Abstract We propose and study a family of universal sequential probability assignments on individual sequences, based on the incremental parsing procedure of the Lempel-Ziv (LZ78) compression algorithm. We show that the normalized log loss under any of these models converges to the normalized LZ78 codelength, uniformly over all individual sequences.

arxiv-2411-19575.title: Fabrication and characterization of InAs nanowire-based quantum dot structures utilizing buried bottom gates
arxiv-2411-19575.creator: Anton Faustmann, Patrick Liebisch, Benjamin Bennemann, Pujitha Perla, Mihail Ion Lepsa, Alexander Pawlis, Detlev Grützmacher, Joachim Knoch, Thomas Schäpers
arxiv-2411-19575.description: Abstract Semiconductor nanowires can be utilized to create quantum dot qubits. The formation of quantum dots is typically achieved by means of bottom gates created by a lift-off process. As an alternative, we fabricated flat buried bottom gate structures by filling etched trenches in a Si substrate with sputtered TiN, followed by mechanical polishing.

arxiv-2501-15807.title: No-Go Theorem for Generic Simulation of Qubit Channels with Finite Classical Resources
arxiv-2501-15807.creator: Sahil Gopalkrishna Naik, Mani Zartab, Nicolas Gisin, Manik Banik
arxiv-2501-15807.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sahil Gopalkrishna Naik, Mani Zartab, Nicolas Gisin, Manik Banik. The mathematical framework of quantum theory, though fundamentally distinct from classical physics, raises the question of whether quantum processes can be efficiently simulated using classical resources. For instance, a sender (Alice) possessing the classical description of a qubit state can simulate the action of a qubit channel through finite classical communication with a receiver (Bob), enabling Bob to reproduce measurement statistics for any observable on the state.

arxiv-2505-10185.title: The CoT Encyclopedia : Analyzing, Predicting, and Controlling how a Reasoning Model will Think
arxiv-2505-10185.creator: Seongyun Lee, Seungone Kim, Minju Seo, Yongrae Jo, Dongyoung Go, Hyeonbin Hwang, Jinho Park, Xiang Yue, Sean Welleck, Graham Neubig, Moontae Lee, Minjoon Seo, KAIST AI, Carnegie Mellon University, LG AI Research, NAVER Search US, Cornell University
arxiv-2505-10185.description: Abstract Long chain-of-thought (CoT) is an essential ingredient in effective usage of modern large language models, but our understanding of the reasoning strategies underlying these capabilities remains limited. While some prior works have attempted to categorize CoTs using predefined strategy types, such approaches are constrained by human intuition and fail to capture the full diversity of model behaviors.

arxiv-2510-13326.title: DEF-YOLO: Leveraging YOLO for Concealed Weapon Detection in Thermal Imaging
arxiv-2510-13326.creator: Divya Bhardwaj *, Arnav Ramamoorthy, Poonam Goyal *
arxiv-2510-13326.description: Abstract Concealed weapon detection aims at detecting weapons hidden beneath a person’s clothing or luggage. Various imaging modalities like Millimeter Wave, Microwave, Terahertz, Infrared, etc., are exploited for the concealed weapon detection task. These imaging modalities have their own limitations, such as poor resolution in microwave imaging, privacy concerns in millimeter wave imaging, etc.

pmc-10637669.title: Genome-wide association analysis of anthracnose resistance in the Yellow Bean Collection of Common Bean
pmc-10637669.creator: Kuwabo Kuwabo, Swivia M. Hamabwe, Paul Kachapulula, Karen Cichy, Travis Parker, Chikoti Mukuma, Kelvin Kamfwa, Karthikeyan Adhimoolam, Karthikeyan Adhimoolam, Karthikeyan Adhimoolam, Karthikeyan Adhimoolam
pmc-10637669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Anthracnose caused by Colletotrichum lindemuthianum is a major disease of common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) worldwide. Yellow beans are a major market class of common bean especially in eastern and southern Africa. The Yellow Bean Collection (YBC), which is comprised of 255 genotypes, and has not been used previously in genetic studies on anthracnose, is an excellent genetic resource for understanding the extent of anthracnose resistance and its genetic architecture in the yellow bean market class.

pmc-11509897.title: Emerging Thermosensitive Probes Based on Triamino-Phenazinium Dyes
pmc-11509897.creator: Tatiana Munteanu, Frédéric Brunel, Michel Camplo, Olivier Siri, Liudmil Antonov
pmc-11509897.description: Temperature is an essential physical characteristic that influences all biological processes. Building on previous research on dialkylamino-functionalized rhodamine-based thermo-sensors, we investigate herein the thermosensitive properties of triamino-phenazinium dyes. Through a simple five-step synthetic route, we synthesized amino-phenazinium chromophores 6 and 7, featuring diethylamine substituents at different positions.

pmc-11565367.title: A robotic-assisted thymectomy is equivalent to a transsternal resection in large thymomas
pmc-11565367.creator: Shaikha Al-Thani, Mohamed Rahouma, Jonathan Villena-Vargas, Oliver Chow, Sebron Harrison, Benjamin Lee, Nasser Altorki, Jeffrey Port
pmc-11565367.description: BackgroundRobotic-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (RATS) is widely accepted for small-to-moderate-size thymomas. However, limited data exists comparing the feasibility of RATS for large tumors ≥5 cm. The aim of this study is to compare the oncological and perioperative outcomes of open thymectomy (OT) versus RATS for these larger tumors.MethodsThe National Cancer Database (2010–2020) was queried for patients who underwent RATS and OT.

pmc-11605456.title: Balancing safety and efficacy of low-molecular-weight heparins in neonates: a systematic review
pmc-11605456.creator: Marieke Verweij, Mirjam M. van Weissenbruch, Irene L.M. Klaassen
pmc-11605456.description: The rising incidence of venous thromboembolism (VTE) in neonates has led to increased use of low-molecular-weight heparins (LMWHs), but optimal dosages remain uncertain. A serious adverse effect of LMWHs is major bleeding. Given the vulnerability of neonates to major bleeding, we aimed to review therapeutic and prophylactic LMWH dosages to achieve target anti-factor Xa ranges of 0.5 and 1.

pmc-12610624.title: Comparative Analysis of Mucosa-Associated and Luminal Gut Microbiota in Pediatric Ulcerative Colitis
pmc-12610624.creator: Takeo Kondo, Sonoko Kondo, Haruyuki Nakayama-Imaohji, Ayano Tada, Nafisa Tabassum, Emmanuel Munyeshyaka, Kosuke Koyano, Shinji Nakamura, Takashi Kusaka, Tomomi Kuwahara, Changwon Yang
pmc-12610624.description: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), including ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn’s disease, are chronic disorders relating to gut microbiota dysbiosis. Despite severe pancolitis being more prevalent in pediatric UC than in adults, alterations in the colon mucosa-associated microbiota (MAM) and their association with disease severity remain to be elucidated.
